### 2026-10-10 – ![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/7XyE1NHdZUtiYCu1Cvz8kC5OvtAJ8NdC/fb925ebeeaf956d6e70d13a1f2651108ddad820f3a829b98e9bd4cd7a5048012.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/7XyE1NHdZUtiYCu1Cvz8kC5OvtAJ8NdC/fb925ebeeaf956d6e70d13a1f2651108ddad820f3a829b98e9bd4cd7a5048012.png)
I made a schematic in kicad
it took a while and this was the process:

so i started with adding the brain of the project which is the esp32 supermini and then i added an led, and a ir receiver which took a while to get because i had to find the specific model schematic and footprint, then i added a transistor between the led and the esp32 so it could output more current resulting in more range hopefully also then i added 4 different buttons which will be used to control the device, then i added the ssd1306 oled 128x64 display which will display the settings and menu yeah and that is probably it, this took me like 4.5 hours because of finding different symbols and footprints for kicad
